# Ideas & Concept Brief Template

Use this brief when pitching a new book to **Editor (`editor`)** before writing starts.

## Story Identity
- **Working Title:** e.g. *Pip the Cloud-Dragon and the Whispering Storm*
- **Folder Slug (`books/`):** e.g. `Valley_of_Dragons/Pip_and_the_Storm` (or top-level `books/<Slug>`)
- **Universe / Series:** Valley of Dragons | Paths of Magic | Standalone
- **Series Order (`children_order`):** Append after existing books in series `meta.json`, or `standalone`
- **Target Age & Tone:** e.g. Ages 5–7 · Warm bedtime picture book (gentle wonder, calm ending)

## Premise & Emotional Arc
- **Opening Hook:** One sentence describing the protagonist and cozy starting world.
- **Core Problem / Journey:** What challenge sets the story in motion?
- **Warm Resolution:** How the hero grows and restores harmony by the final page.

## Canon & Continuity Anchors (`knowledge/`)
- List established characters, locations, or magic rules referenced (or note `"Original cast within Valley of Dragons backdrop"`).
- Record any open lore questions for Editor review at Gate G1 instead of inventing unverified canon.

## Production Switches (Optional Features)
- **Combat Mini-Game (`enemy_metadata.json`):** `skip` (bedtime / pure story) | `enable` (friendlier encounters only)
- **Music Mode (`song.mp3`):** `gemini_lyria` (Auto) | `suno` (Custom style + operator `.mp3` upload)
